items.appliesWhen: You set --banner-ic-mt anywhere. It is a global geometry token, not a --ds-* component hook, so an app that only overrides --ds-banner-* is unaffected.
items.pitfall: Deleting the override is the whole fix, but only because the icon no longer needs nudging: it is now centred on the message block rather than aligned to the first line. If you had raised the value to line the icon up with a taller first line, that adjustment is now working against the new rule and will push the icon off centre.
items.verify: A ds-banner with two or more lines of body text shows its icon vertically centred on the text block, and no rule in your app references --banner-ic-mt.
items.restore: There is no one-line restore. `align-self: flex-start` on the icon does not reproduce the old look: it drops the one border-width of nudge the token supplied on a banner (the toast never read it — its own 2px came from a margin, removed with the same change), and a consumer's `ds-banner .icon` is specificity (0,1,1) against the component's own (0,4,0), so it does not win at all. On a `compact` banner it is actively wrong, because that variant was already centred before this change. If you must have the old alignment, fork the component's stylesheet.
items.note: The token was one border-width of optical bump, and it existed only to serve the first-line alignment rule. With the icon centred on the block there is nothing left for it to correct.
items.action: Delete any --banner-ic-mt declaration. There is no replacement token.

informational: The banner, toast and alert icon now centres on the message block instead of aligning to the first line of text. Nothing to change: it is a visual default, applied by the components themselves. One-line messages look identical either way, which covers most toasts; the difference grows with the text, and was 12px at two lines and 21px at three.

ToastService.promise() and any toast with an `action` changed their dismissal timing. A settled promise toast now counts its 4s/6s from when it becomes visible rather than from when the promise resolved, so one queued behind `maxVisible` is no longer removed before it is shown. A toast with an `action` no longer auto-dismisses at all and is always dismissible, because the region is last in tab order and the button was unreachable within the old five seconds. Hovering or focusing the region pauses every countdown. Nothing to change in consumer code; if you relied on an action toast disappearing on its own, dismiss it from the action handler.

Inside a `ds-color="error"`, `="success"` or `="warning"` zone, anything that reads the scoped accent's strong colour now renders in that status colour instead of falling back to body text — selected list and tree rows, the active sidenav item and its rail, the active tab pill, avatar initials, the active tag, dropzone text and the toast's action label. Nothing to change: those three families simply never defined the role the zone asked for, and the pointer now asks for the name they do define. A zone whose accent looked plain before will now look coloured, which is the intended appearance.
